experiments.scope: Scaled grouped birthday on exact 2-round BLAKE3 root compression via m15 partial evaluation. 32 groups x 32 consecutive m15 (N_t=2^10). Distinguished event is a 20-bit digest-xor-mask with N_t^2/2^w = 1, matching full-scale N^2/2^256 = 1. Parameters fixed before production runs. Digests computed only by the partial evaluator; organizer re-verifies pairs with the trusted digest.
experiments.hypothesis: Under H1-grouped-digests, the masked collision-detection frequency at this scale is near the random-model success probability (~0.393 for the birthday coverage event with N_t^2/2^w = 1), supporting that structured group prefixes do not grossly suppress masked collisions for the truncated 2-round map.

experiments.scope: Most structured layout: one group with m15 = 0..1023 on the same partial evaluator. Different 20-bit digest-xor-mask (lanes o3,o4,o5). Parameters fixed before production runs.
experiments.hypothesis: Even a single shared prefix with exhaustive m15 does not show large masked-collision deviation from the random model at this scale under H1.
